g.text: Founded in Aragonda in 2012, our school blends rigorous learning with
yoga, discipline and value-based education—preparing every child to thrive.
Daily guided yoga builds focus, balance,
achievement on and beyond the field.
Empowering every child to realise their fullest
potential and contribute meaningfully to society.
Our responsibility is to help them discover it, nurture it,
and give them confidence to pursue their aspirations with
integrity and purpose. Learning here extends far beyond
